name: zcode
description: The ZCode micro-behaviour round of docs/dev/v1/zcode-details.md, driven live through the automation tree: palette history chips, answer hover-bar copy feedback and time label, the sidebar session context menu (mark unread / copy path), the queue-recall draft guard and the alt-t thinking cycle. (The model-menu drill-down scenario was replaced by r5-model-picker-modal in round 5, round5.md §2 #1.)

scenarios.covers: alt-t cycles the thinking level, level menu shows it checked
⌘K history chips, ⌥2 applies one, per-chip × forgets it, palette stays open
answer hover bar: Copy → check glyph, arrival time label, 'Thought for Ns'
session context menu: Mark as unread ↔ Mark read, Copy session path, Pin
recall into a non-empty composer keeps the item and toasts; empty draft recalls
